title: --workdir does not scope the changelog on Windows

environment.notes: On Linux and macOS fs::canonicalize returns a plain path and the separator is '/', so the check passes at the base commit.

hidden_tests.notes: The upstream PR's unit tests call a helper the PR introduces (workdir_include_pattern), so they would leak the fix's shape. This black-box check runs the built binary on a throwaway repository instead.
